name: Australian Capital Territory
flagName: Flag of the Australian Capital Territory
summary: A blue band at the hoist with the Southern Cross in white, beside a white field bearing a modified version of the City of Canberra's coat of arms, with a black swan and a white swan.
origin: The ACT gained self-government in 1989. A flag designed by Ivo Ostyn, chosen after public consultation, was adopted on 25 March 1993.

colors.name: Gold
colors.meaning: The crown and details of the arms.

symbols.name: Shield
symbols.description: A castle, a sword of justice, a mace and a crown.
symbols.meaning: The capital, justice and parliamentary government.

facts: Its two swans stand for Aboriginal and non-Aboriginal Australians.
The ACT contains Canberra, the national capital.
The motto 'For the Queen, the Law and the People' appears on the arms.
clues: A blue band with the Southern Cross beside white with a shield held by a black swan and a white swan.
Its swans stand for two groups of Australians.
The flag of the territory containing the national capital.
